title: 第2章：狂撞丧尸的无敌房车！
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

房车在高速上跑了二十多公里，林昊的手都还在抖。

这不是怕，是肾上腺素退潮之后的正常生理反应，完全控制不了！。

方向盘被他捏得咯吱响，双手像焊在方向盘上似的。

看了几遍后视镜，确定已经摆脱危险，才长舒了一口气。

时速慢慢降了下去六十，五十，四十……

林昊把车停在应急车道上，熄了火。

他把额头抵在方向盘上，闭眼，数自己的心跳。

一百三，一百二，一百一……

慢慢的平复自己的心跳。

但脑子里还是那个画面，女店员脖子上那块黑洞洞缺口，连骨头都露了出来，还有双没有黑眼珠的眼睛……

短短十几秒，活人变死人，死了就死了，居然还可以站起来咬人。

他脑袋嗡嗡的，忍不住删了

疼～～脸火辣辣的疼，但现在脑子清醒了一些。

系统面板依然悬浮在他的视野右侧，半透明的蓝色光屏，安安静静的显示在他面前。

林昊伸手去碰，指尖穿过光屏，没有实体触感，但面板识别了他的意图，自动展开了完整界面。

面板上的信息量远比他想象中的要大。

【末日房车升级系统V1.0】

【宿主：林昊】

【当前载具等级：LV1·铁壳房车】

【系统等级上限：LV10】

他往下翻。升级路线图是一棵倒挂的树形结构，从LV1到LV10，每一级都标注着所需材料。

低等级还算简单，基础晶核为主，辅以少量特殊材料。

到了LV5往上，材料名称开始变色，橙色、紫色，有的后面打着问号，意味着他现在连解锁查看的权限都没有。

LV2升级需求：基础晶核×15，精钢板×3，升级图纸×1。

晶核他有现在有两颗。

但是精钢板还不知道从哪里弄。

图纸，任务奖励里面有。

那也就是说，集齐十颗晶核完成新手任务，然后拿到图纸，再搞到精钢板，才能升到LV2。

这破车LV1的防御力才D级，刚才那三只丧尸拍了半天连个裂纹没留下，还算挺靠谱。

但如果来一群呢？十只？二十只？那个服务区最后涌出来多少，简直数不清！

面板左侧有四个功能图标，他逐个点开。

第一个，【物资探测】。

说明写得简洁——以房车为圆心，扫描周围一定范围内的物资与威胁分布。

LV1状态下探测半径5公里，刷新间隔10分钟。

第二个，【房车状态】。

实时数据面板弹出来，油量、车速、轮胎气压、车身损耗率，甚至连储物空间的剩余容量都标得明明白白。

当前油量67%，续航约255公里。车身损耗率3%，刚才撞那两只丧尸留下的。

第三个，【升级商店】。

货架几乎全是灰颜色的，是锁着的……

仅有的两件可兑换物品：【简易车窗栅栏·图纸】3晶核、【备用轮胎】2晶核。

其余全标着“等级不足，暂未解锁”。

第四个，【任务系统】。

除了那个还挂着的新手任务，下面还有一行灰字：【更多任务将随等级提升解锁。】

林昊靠回座椅，盯着车顶发了一会儿呆。

LV1，D级防御，最高时速100，续航三百公里出头。

储物空间5立方米，塞点吃喝就差不多满了。

这东西在太平年月是辆勉强能开的破车，但在这末世里，就是个铁皮棺材，当然比走路，还是强了很多。

如果不升级，那肯定是死路一条。

他点开物资探测，地图加载了两秒，一个简化版的俯瞰图铺开在面板上。

高速公路是一条灰白色的线，他的车是一个蓝点。

前方三公里处，一个黄色菱形标记在闪。

【高速收费站（龙泉段）】

【物资信号：中等】

【危险等级：低】

【建议：适合当前等级搜刮】

三公里。

林昊发动引擎，挂挡，踩油门。

车开出去不到一公里，路面开始变了样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The RV drove for more than 20 kilometers on the highway, and Lin Hao's hands were still shaking.

This is not fear, it is a normal physiological reaction after the adrenaline ebbs. It is completely out of control!.

The steering wheel creaked as he squeezed it, as if his hands were welded to the steering wheel.

After checking the rearview mirror several times to make sure he was out of danger, he let out a sigh of relief.

The speed slowly dropped to sixty, fifty, forty...

Lin Hao parked the car in the emergency lane and turned off the engine.

He rested his forehead on the steering wheel, closed his eyes, and counted his heartbeat.

One hundred three, one hundred two, one hundred one...

Slowly calm your heartbeat.

But I still have that image in my mind, the black hole on the female clerk's neck, even the bones are exposed, and there are a pair of eyes without black eyes...

In just ten seconds, a living person turns into a dead person, and when he is dead, he is dead, and he can actually stand up and bite people.

His head was buzzing and he couldn't help but delete it.

It hurts~~ My face is burning, but now my mind is clearer.

The system panel was still floating on the right side of his field of vision, and the translucent blue light screen was displayed quietly in front of him.

Lin Hao reached out to touch it, and his fingertips passed through the light screen. There was no physical touch, but the panel recognized his intention and automatically expanded the complete interface.

The amount of information on the panel was far greater than he imagined.

[Doomsday RV Upgrade System V1.0]

[Host: Lin Hao]

[Current vehicle level: LV1·Iron-shell RV]

[System level upper limit: LV10]

He turned down.The upgrade roadmap is an upside-down tree structure, from LV1 to LV10, with the required materials marked on each level.

The low level is relatively simple, with basic crystal cores as the main component, supplemented by a small amount of special materials.

After reaching LV5 and up, the material names began to change color, orange, purple, and some had question marks behind them, which meant that he did not even have the permission to unlock and view them now.

LV2 upgrade requirements: basic crystal core × 15, refined steel plate × 3, upgrade blueprint × 1.

He has two crystal cores now.

But I don’t know where to get the stainless steel plate yet.

Blueprints and mission rewards are included.

That is to say, you have to collect ten crystal cores to complete the novice mission, then get the blueprints, and then get the stainless steel plate to be promoted to LV2.

The LV1 defense of this broken car is only D level. The three zombies just took a long time to shoot without even leaving a crack, which is quite reliable.

But what if a group comes?Ten?Twenty?How many people ended up pouring out of that service area, I can’t even count them!

There were four function icons on the left side of the panel, and he clicked on them one by one.

The first one is [Material Detection].

The instructions are written concisely - take the RV as the center of the circle and scan the distribution of supplies and threats within a certain range around it.

In LV1 state, the detection radius is 5 kilometers and the refresh interval is 10 minutes.

The second one is [RV Status].

A real-time data panel pops up, and the fuel level, vehicle speed, tire pressure, body wear rate, and even the remaining capacity of the storage space are clearly marked.

The current fuel level is 67% and the range is about 255 kilometers.The body wear rate is 3%, left behind by the two zombies we just hit.

The third one is [Upgrade Store].

The shelves are almost all gray and locked...

There are only two redeemable items: [Simple Window Grill·Drawing] 3 crystal cores, [Spare Tire] 2 crystal cores.

The rest are all marked "Insufficient level, not yet unlocked."

The fourth one is [Task System].

In addition to the still pending novice mission, there is a line of gray text below: [More missions will be unlocked as the level increases.】

Lin Hao leaned back in his seat and stared at the roof of the car for a while.

LV1, D-level defense, top speed of 100, and battery life of just over 300 kilometers.

The storage space is 5 cubic meters, which can be almost full if you stuff some food and drink in it.

In peacetime, this thing was a broken car that could barely be driven, but in these apocalypse, it was just an iron coffin. Of course, it was still much better than walking.

If you don't upgrade, it will definitely be a dead end.

He clicked on the material detection, the map loaded for two seconds, and a simplified version of the bird's eye view was spread out on the panel.

The highway is a gray-white line and his car is a blue dot.

Three kilometers ahead, a yellow diamond-shaped mark flashed.

[High-speed Toll Station (Longquan Section)]

[Material signal: medium]

[Danger level: low]

[Recommendation: Suitable for current level search]

Three kilometers.

Lin Hao started the engine, put it into gear, and stepped on the accelerator.

After driving less than a kilometer, the road began to change.
